notes.note: Speakers verified against 0716.bla (TextIdOffset 0, entry = n+1): #0.19 Ankh; #0.20-#0.34, #0.39-#0.53, #0.61-#0.75 are party-leader blocks; #0.35-#0.36 '???' (CHARA_NAME 30) while Grand Master Gundam is on screen, so voiced as GMG before its self-introduction; #0.37-#0.38, #0.54-#0.55, #0.57 GMG; #0.60, #0.78 Ankh; #0.76-#0.77, #0.79 Seravee's Voice. Script also calls +79 (entry #0.80, Ankh) but the table has no such entry.

Pt_Chara_Check order 8,7,6,10,9,2,1,5,4,3,12,11,15,14,13 = God, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, RX, Rider 1, OOO, W, Den-O, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Taro (same as story_153). Confirmed by the rough variants at k9 (#0.29, #0.48) = Den-O Sword Form/Momotaros. Identical Japanese kept identical. 'Shitennou' = Four Heavenly Kings per glossary; 'shuugoutai' rendered 'amalgam'.
Source has a probable typo (a kanji meaning 'luxuriant' where 'overflowing/filling' is meant); read as Minus Energy filling the space. 'Main power reactor' compressed to 'main reactor'.

'It should stop functioning' = the Devil Gundam (merged with the Cube) - settled by #0.61 asking whether the Devil Gundam stopped. Kept 'it' since the Devil Gundam is named in the same line. #0.40 (Zeta) differs only in punctuation/structure ('...wasn't, but'); #0.44 (Black RX) adds '!!'; #0.48 Momotaros rough.
'Taoseru mono nara na' (if you can beat me) answers the party's 'if we cut off its power'. #0.55 'Grand Master Gundam-sama' self-honorific -> 'the invincible, mighty'.
New roar, no prior English for Grand Master Gundam: 'Gwaaaa...argh!!' (death cry after the battle).
'Ryouiki no kakudai' = the enemy (Devil Gundam/Cube) territory expanding, as in earlier Seravee lines ('territory under enemy control'). Rendered 'Its territory'.

Label shift: slice labels #0.1 unlabelled and #0.2 '?party', but all 15 rows #0.1-#0.15 are the leader block (0717.bla: TextIdOffset+1+k, same Pt order as 0716). k9 = #0.10 rough (Momotaros), k13 = #0.14 with '-san' (Mebius) confirm #0.1 = k0. Ankh's follow-up line (script +16) has no table entry.
Mebius variant adds '-san' to Seravee; honorific dropped, politeness carried by slightly more formal wording.

0718.bla: #0.1 Ankh, #0.2-#0.16 leader block with its own Pt order 1,5,2,4,3,11,15,12,14,13,6,10,7,9,8 -> #0.2 Rider 1, #0.3 OOO, #0.4 RX, #0.5 W, #0.6 Den-O Sword (rough 'takee'), #0.7 Ultraman. Labels correct here.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0716/0717/0718 bytecode. 0717 label shift: leader block is #0.1-#0.15 (not #0.2+); 0716 '???' #0.35-0.36 voiced as Grand Master Gundam. #0.38 source typo read as 'filling'. New roar: Grand Master Gundam 'Gwaaa...argh!!'. No new names; 'Four Heavenly Kings' per glossary.
